# file-type-palette

The colours file-type glyphs are drawn in: one `--file-<tone>` per tone of
`primitives/file-type`'s closed `FileTone` set, plus `--folder`. Dark values
are Seti's palette; light values are those darkened (VS Code's rule), so a
theme can retune them like any other token group (customizer section "File
types").

The keys are a contract with `primitives/file-type` (`fileToneVar(tone)` names
`--file-<tone>`): adding a tone means adding its key here.

## Plugin reference

- Web:

  - Uses: `ui/theme-engine.ThemeEngine`
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `ui/theme-engine.defineTokenGroup`
    - `ui/theme-engine.TokenGroupSchema`
  - Exports (types): `FileTypePaletteValues`
  - Exports (values): `fileTypePaletteGroup`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Tokens used by: `primitives/file-type`
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/file-explorer/shell`
    - `ui/tokens/file-type-palette/customizer`
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`customizer`** — Customizer section for the file-type colour token group (--file-<tone>, --folder).
